articleTitle: Integrating SMOTE and LIME Techniques for Enhanced Stroke Prediction using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Stroke, a medical condition that occurs when there is a disruption in blood flow to the brain, leading to damage to brain cells. It is typically caused by either a blockage in a blood vessel (ischemic stroke) or a blood vessel rupture (hemorrhagic stroke). This study offers a holistic approach to addressing class imbalance in machine learning, specifically assessing the usefulness of the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) in conjunction with Z-scaling or standardization on a dataset. Various machine learning models, namely Logistic Regression, Support Vector Classifier, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, AdaBoost Classifier, XGB Classifier, K-nearest Neighbors, CatBoost Classifier, and Gradient Boosting Classifier, are evaluated using LIME explainable AI for model interpretability and analyzing various performance metrics. Notably, Random Forest demonstrates superior performance relative to other models, achieving an accuracy of 94.70%. This research contributes valuable insights for the development of diagnostic tools for enhancing stroke prediction.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Traceability System for Food Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Food industry professionals and consumers alike take food safety seriously. The complexity of the food supply chain makes it difficult to trace the provenance and quality of food products, which can result in contamination, fraud, and ineffective recalls. To improve transparency, traceability, and accountability throughout the food supply chain, blockchain technology has emerged as a possible alternative. It examines how blockchain technology and food safety interact, highlighting how it could fundamentally alter how we monitor, confirm, and protect the quality of our food. This work proposes a Blockchain based food traceability system provides a safe and tamper-proof platform for tracking each step of the food journey by establishing an immutable and decentralized ledger of transactions. It has been implemented with the essential characteristics of blockchain, such as data immutability, transparency, smart contracts, and decentralized consensus and could successfully trace the food chain steps.

articleTitle: UAV Object Detection and Tracking in Video using YOLOv3 and Deepsort
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The popularity of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), also referred to as drones, is growing quickly, raising questions about their misuse as they become more widely available. This escalating trend underscores the urgency for effective drone detection mechanisms to prevent unlawful intrusions and ensure public safety. To bridge the existing gap in technology, There’s a deliberate attempt to develop sophisticated deep-learning models capable of accurately recognizing drones of varying shapes and forms, including those that resemble birds. In our quest to address this challenge, we have adopted a comprehensive approach by utilizing the YOLOv3 object detection model alongside OpenCV. Through meticulous training on a diverse dataset encompassing images of drones, including bird-like variations, we have achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 96.98% at 0.5 mAP. Moreover, our integration of DeepSORT with YOLO enhances the system’s tracking capabilities, enabling efficient monitoring and tracking of identified drones. In conclusion, our endeavor not only fills a crucial void in current drone detection technology but also underscores our commitment to safeguarding against potential threats posed by drone misuse. Through continuous advancements in deep-learning methodologies and innovative integration techniques, we aim to establish robust frameworks for automated UAV detection, ensuring the security and integrity of airspace operations.

articleTitle: Integrity Shield: Defending Genuine Goods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The rise in counterfeit products poses a significant challenge for consumers, businesses, and governments worldwide. Counterfeit goods not only impact the economy but also pose health and safety risks. Traditional methods of combating counterfeiting have proven inadequate, necessitating the exploration of innovative solutions. This report focuses on the utilization of blockchain technology for fake product identification.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition: Advancing Human-Computer Interaction through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Sign language is an essential tool for communication among individuals with hearing impairments.The recent progress in computer vision and machine learning has significantly advanced the development of systems that recognize and interpret sign language, contributing to their evolution.These systems play a vital role in bridging communication gaps by automatically identifying and interpreting sign language gestures, facilitating seamless and effective communication. This paper reviews and analyzes sign language recognition systems, covering methodologies and potential applications, including data collection, hand and gesture tracking, feature extraction, and classification algorithms. The goal is to promote inclusivity and equal opportunities by fostering communication between sign language users and the broader community.

articleTitle: AcademicVid: Academic PDFs to video generation - Exploratory Literature Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Amidst the dynamic landscape of online education, a notable response emerges to address the widespread utilization of academic lecture PDFs and the associated challenges confronting students. This initiative seeks to leverage cutting-edge generative AI technology to condense extensive academic lecture materials into concise and informative video summaries. These video lectures serve as valuable resources, offering students an expeditious and effective means to comprehend key concepts across various subjects, spanning all semesters and modules. This undertaking’s significance lies in its capacity to transform lengthy and intricate lecture materials into succinct video summaries, thereby enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of learning. This approach is particularly crucial in the contemporary educational climate, where there is a substantial demand for digital learning materials.

articleTitle: Navigating Landscapes through AI: A Comparative Study of EfficientNet and MobileNetV2 in Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis of two state-of-the-art deep learning models, EfficientNet, and MobileNetV2, fine-tuned for the task of intel image classification into four categories: urban areas, trails, outdoors & seas. The aim was to rate and contrast these models’ accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores to identify which will be appropriate for those who are analyzing images to classify geographical and natural environments. In this study, the datasets, which were extracted from an online repository known as Kaggle, were used to train both models and they were evaluated using the structured methodology that entails data preprocessing, model training including hyperparameter optimization and performance evaluation. The outcome projected that EfficientNet was better than MobileNetV2 in all the metrics, providing the highest accuracy but with a balanced precision-recall and f1-scores criteria. Nevertheless, MobileNetV2’s computational efficiency instead of resource limitations represents a promising possibility and viability of its application in these settings. This research gives a contribution to the literature being a development of knowledge encompassing abilities and failures of the models applied to the work on classification of intel images, showing the significance of a model selection based on the project peculiarities and computational resource availability. This study individually contributes to improving the deeply learned models derived for environmental and urban landscape analysis, but also creates a guide to future ambitious research and practical work in the same field.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Emotions In Kannada Sentence With Homonyms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The sentimental analysis especially with homonym words in vernacular language is a challenging process. Even though Kannada experts have studied the classification of emotions, there is still misunderstanding when words have diverse meanings. This research focuses on the categorization of Emotions and No Emotions in Kannada sentences, leveraging machine learning techniques particularly Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Naive Bayes. The work uses preprocessing approaches to solve linguistic oddities with a dataset of 271 (160 Emotion and 110 No Emotion) hand labelled Kannada sentences. Feature extraction involves methods such as Bag-of-words and TF-IDF. Emotion recognition models are created using the SVM and Naive Bayes algorithm. Naive Bayes demonstrated the maximum accuracy at 70.90% while SVM performed with an accuracy of 56.36%.

articleTitle: BIOWATCH: Detecting the Lake Pollution to Safeguard Biotic Life
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This study presents an integrated system devised to combat plastic pollution in lakes autonomously, eliminating the need for human intervention. Utilizing sensor data and camera imagery processed through the YOLO algorithm. The detected plastic is then used to compute its density, which is subsequently compared against a predetermined threshold. Upon surpassing the threshold, an automated email notification containing the density values is dispatched to relevant authorities. Furthermore, water quality sensors are integrated to monitor environmental conditions continuously. Regular updates are provided to facilitate proactive measures in pollution prevention. This initiative underscores the application of cutting-edge technology to address environmental issues and uphold the well-being of aquatic ecosystems. Through automated detection and monitoring processes, the system offers a sustainable approach to combat plastic pollution in lakes, promoting environmental conservation efforts.

articleTitle: ElectroPath: A Predictive Model for Electric Vehicle Range Optimization Through Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This research paper delves into the realm of Electric Vehicles (EVs), with a primary focus on alleviating range anxiety - a persistent concern among EV owners. Through an extensive survey among EV owners, we have identified key challenges, including the lack of real-time information, worries about charging infrastructure, and the desire for community engagement. In response to these findings, we introduce “EV- Connect,” a mobile application designed to address these concerns comprehensively. EV-Connect offers real-time battery status updates, route optimization, a charging station locator, and a community platform for EV enthusiasts. Our research underscores the importance of continued collaboration among stakeholders in the EV ecosystem and highlights the need for adaptive solutions to evolving user needs and technologies. By facilitating a seamless and user-friendly EV experience, tools like EV-Connect contribute to the broader adoption of electric vehicles and a sustainable future.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Information Accessibility Through a Generative Medical Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Today, the demand for readily accessible and accurate healthcare information has grown significantly. This paper focuses on the implementation of a medical chatbot, capable of answering healthcare-related queries. By incorporating the capabilities of Llama 2, a generative large language model from Meta, the chatbot developed is capable of skillfully navigating the intricacies of user queries while providing accurate and context-specific information. Furthermore, the system leverages the ChainLit UI Library, a modern front-end technology that enhances the user experience with an appealing interface. Through this synergy of advanced language capabilities and a user-friendly interface, we aim to contribute to the accessibility of trustworthy healthcare information, ultimately improving patient care and supporting healthcare professionals in their tasks.

articleTitle: Intelligent Learning Analytics through E-learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In the current educational landscape, the preparation for placements often encounters a critical challenge which is the lack of personalized and adaptive learning experiences. Traditional approaches to placement preparation adopt a one-size-fits-all methodology, neglecting the unique strengths, weaknesses, and learning preferences of individual students. This leads to suboptimal outcomes, where students may struggle with certain subjects while excelling in others, yet lack the tailored support necessary to navigate their academic journey effectively. The prevailing gap in personalized education is intensified by the absence of a cohesive platform that integrates assessments, predictive analytics, and personalized learning paths. The solution seeks to revolutionize education by introducing a tailored, data-driven solution that addresses the core problem of contrasting learning outcomes. The primary objective is to empower students in their preparation for placements by seamlessly integrating assessments, machine learning predictions, and personalized learning paths. The proposed solution amalgamates education, technology, and mentorship, resolving the persistent issue of standardized learning approaches. By harnessing machine learning, we aim to provide a nuanced understanding of students’ capabilities and deliver targeted interventions that optimize their preparation for placements. This heralds a new era in education, where data-driven personalization becomes the cornerstone for unlocking the full potential of every learner.

articleTitle: Identification of Emotions in a Given Speech Audio Clip by Using ANN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Understanding and decoding human emotions from speech audio is a compelling challenge in the field of affective computing. This article focuses on the functioning of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to the task of identifying emotions within speech audio clips. The ability to accurately recognize emotions in speech has broad implications, from enhancing human computer interaction to providing invaluable insights into mental health assessments. The research methodology involves collecting a diverse dataset of speech audio clips, each carefully annotated with specific emotional states, like joy, sadness, anger, surprise, and neutrality. Relevant acoustic structures counting pitch, intensity, spectral characteristics, and rhythm patterns, are extracted from these audio clips, thereby creating a feature-rich dataset for ANN training. ANNs are chosen as the primary model based on machine learning concepts for this task. The training process involves iterative adjustments of the ANN’s internal parameters to reduce the disparity between predicted emotions and the ground truth labels. Various architectures, such as feedforward networks or more advanced models like recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are explored to identify the effective approach. To determine the performance of the trained ANN, a separate test dataset is used, and standard evaluation metrics including recall, precision, accuracy and confusion matrices are employed. The results proven useful perceptions into the ANN’s ability to accurately identify emotions in a given speech audio clips.

articleTitle: Hotel Reservation App Integrated with Docker and Jenkins
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In today’s digital landscape, establishing a robust online presence is paramount for businesses looking to harness the full potential of the internet. It exploits the seamless integration of Docker and Jenkins for better efficiency and scalability. The main goal is to simplify the hotel booking procedure by providing users with an easy-to-use interface that makes reservations simple. Throughout the many phases of development, testing, and deployment, the integration of Docker guarantees a consistent and portable environment. A streamlined Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) process through Docker and Jenkins, all orchestrated with Git.Docker containerization. This containerization method makes the application more dependable and makes managing dependencies easier. Additionally, Jenkins automation makes continuous integration and delivery easier, guaranteeing dependable and quick application upgrades. The cooperative synergy between Docker and Jenkins improves the Hotel Reservation App’s overall performance and maintainability by optimizing resource utilization and offering a solid and scalable basis. Detailed room information is readily available, and security remains a top priority with a one-time password (OTP) login mechanism and JSON Web Token (JWT) integration for secure user sessions.

articleTitle: Prediction of Tensile Properties from Micro-structure in Metallic Alloys using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Design for ‘fail-safe’ of a structural component includes early prediction of its remnant life under known service loading conditions, preventing catastrophic failure of the component during service. Currently, numerical techniques to determine the remnant life are popular among structural engineers but are time consuming and need substantial experimentation to validate predictions. Off late, researchers are exploring use of appropriate Machine Learning Algorithms (MLAs) for life prediction and seems an alternative approach as it would be quick and relies on data available in the literature. Predicting the tensile strength properties from microstructural information of a structural material is envisaged in the present work. Eventually, the tensile data information would be used in predicting the remnant life of the component. Exhaustive data is available in literature on the microstructural information of most structural alloys. The present work uses the convolutional neural network (CNN) technique to predict the tensile properties in metals and alloys using microstructural images. For this purpose, 20% of the data was used for testing while the rest was used for training. The CNN takes the material microstructure as input to detect the patterns and map necessary features to predict the tensile properties viz., yield stress and ultimate strength. The prediction shows good correlation (< 20% error in few cases) with the experimental results from the literature and exhibits a ‘proof-of-concept’ for future work.

articleTitle: Intelligent Plant Watering System: Smart city
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In the present situation, human beings are very busy in their daily routine, making them not have enough time to take care of the plants. By making use of advanced technology such as the Internet of Things (IoT) one can design a system that can be used to monitor and update the progress of plant growth and provide plants with the required amount of water by helping the owner in taking care of plants even in their absentia. This paper presents a system for watering plants that considers weather conditions as one of the main parameters that can be taken from Google Weather and present conditions of the plant from the sensor. The system makes use of three sensors namely temperature, humidity, and soil moisture. Both data from Google and sensors are analyzed using an ML model to predict whether to water the plant and how much water should be given to the plant at the scheduled time.

articleTitle: Blockchain-NFT Enabled Privacy and Ownership Protection System for Genomics[POPS-G]
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Genomics plays a pivotal role in identifying genetic factors that contribute to the development of diseases. By studying the genomic profiles of individuals, scientists can pinpoint genetic mutations associated with various diseases, including cancer, diabetes, and genetic disorders. The privacy and security of this data during analysis and maintenance is a major concern. To make personalized medicine more effective, panomics studies aim to integrate genomics with other types of data, such as electronic health record (EHR) data and image data. This requires the creation of secure and reliable pipelines that consider ethical concerns, confidentiality and data ownership. To address these issues, we propose an NFT-based blockchain system that can make genomics data handling and research more secure, efficient, and simple while preserving privacy and ownership. Our paper also aims to identify obstacles in sharing EHR and genomic data and proves the potential of blockchain withNFTtechnology in providingcontrolled genomics data handling protecting privacy and ownership.

articleTitle: Comparing Hindustani Music Raga Prediction Systems using DL and ML Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This project aims to employ DL and ML techniques to predict ragas in Indian classical music accurately. The focus is on developing a system that can process audio recordings and make precise raga predictions. The classification task utilizes CNN and RNN networks, to enhance performance. Extensive evaluation using diverse recordings is conducted, comparing the framework against traditional methods. The outcomes of this project has potential applications for music analysis, archiving, recommendation systems, and education in Indian classical music. The developed raga prediction framework can serve as a valuable tool for automatic raga identification. Additionally, it contributes to the field of music information retrieval by showcasing the capabilities of DL/ML techniques in tackling musical tasks.

articleTitle: Exploring BioClinical BERT’s NLP Capabilities with Explainability Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Natural Language Processing has gained significant attention in the world of Information Technology and is experiencing rapid growth. Its applications span across various domains, with a notable surge in its utilization within the healthcare industry. This has fueled the development of language models that are trained on a large amount of clinical data, like Bio+Clinical BERT. However, there remains a crucial concern regarding the trustworthiness of NLP models. Traditional accuracy measures alone may not be sufficient to instill confidence in their reliability. In this study, we address this concern by exploring the application of Explainability to NLP tasks in the healthcare sector. We employ Explainability techniques to gain deeper insights into the underlying mechanisms and evaluate the trustworthiness of fine-tuned models based on Bio+Clinical BERT. Specifically, LIME and SHAP techniques have been utilized to produce explanations, which prove instrumental in enhancing our understanding of the models, as well as identifying their strengths and weaknesses.

articleTitle: Stream Flow Prediction: Narmada Basin
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In river basins that are prone to flooding and drought, streamflow forecasting is essential for managing water resources. In this study, we used two machine learning methods, LSTM and Prophet, to estimate streamflow at a river location in the Narmada Basin, India. A forecasting model known as the Prophet was built expressly to forecast time series data that include seasonal and trend components. A recurrent neural network that can identify long-term patterns in data is the LSTM model. We tested and trained the LSTM and Prophet models using historical streamflow data from the Narmada Basin. The results showed that both models could accurately project streamflow at the river site, especially during the monsoon season. But overall, the LSTM model barely outperformed the Prophet model. We also found that the LSTM model could account for the non-linear relationship between streamflow and meteorological factors like rainfall and temperature. Because of the Narmada Basin’s unique hydrology and climate, the LSTM model is a valuable tool for predicting streamflow there.

articleTitle: Revised IEEE 802.11 MAC protocol for an Energy Efficient and Optimized Wireless Communication in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In the world of wireless communication, the Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol sports a pivotal task in managing access to the shared communication medium. This project proposes a change to the existing IEEE 802.11 MAC protocol by introducing a modification in the sensing process. The conventional algorithm incorporates Short Inter-Frame Space (SIFS), DIFS (Distributed Inter-Frame Space) and backoff periods to regulate channel access. The proposed modification seeks to experiment the protocol by eliminating SIFS, thereby focusing solely on backoff and DIFS. This will reduce the delay each node waits before transmitting the packet. Eventually the reduction in wait time, reduces the energy consumed thus optimized the energy usage of nodes. To evaluate the efficacy of the modified protocol, a wireless network simulation is conducted in NS2. The simulation provides insights into the behavior of the network under the altered MAC protocol, shedding light on its performance and potential advantages.

articleTitle: Developing a Comprehensive Hybrid Model Utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forest for the Advanced Classification of Tomato Rot Disease Severity Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This study proposed a relatively new hybrid model integrating Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Random Forest (RF) for the classification of tomato fruit rot diseases into five different levels, according to graded severity levels. Breaking with the norm of the primitive and one-sided machine learning techniques in the strong categorization and the precise diagnosis of plant diseases, this research stands out for applying the deep learning potential of convolutional neural networks and the multifaceted strength of random forest for the extraction of features and the classification accordingly. The newly proposed mixed methodology, including data acquisition, preprocessing, training, and validation, indicates the hybrid model with excellent performance where the accuracy measurement was 93.5%. Besides, this portrays a significant change because it is already better compared to the current models, and it evidences its potential in the fight against weather variability and the improvement of disease management. The study results suggest that the integration of deep and ensemble learning methods in the agricultural sector is possible, wherefore their perspectives can become a base for future practical applications as a worthwhile goal. The work is substantial and represents a significant contribution to the field of agricultural informatics and plant pathology in that there is a robust tool for early disease detection and severity classification that will directly lead to quick and informative management decisions.

articleTitle: InterviewPal - Elevating Interview Automation with Deep Learning and Natural Language Processing Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In today’s competitive job market, preparation for interviews is crucial for securing desired positions. As the interview process can be daunting, an interactive and personalized practice platform can significantly assist candidates in honing their interview skills. The research work holds significance as numerous young students aspire to excel in interviews but lack a suitable platform to assess their readiness for interviews. The research on interview bots is actively progressing, focusing on realistic simulations, personalized feedback, and multimodal capabilities for enhanced user experience, aiming to provide effective and accessible interview preparation. This research work aims to develop an “Interactive Interview Bot,” a virtual assistant designed to provide an immersive and dynamic environment for interview practice and skill improvement.The purpose of the Interactive Interview Bot is to offer users a simulated interview experience, tailored to their needs and skill levels. The bot will not only help users rehearse common interview questions but also provide personalized feedback, guidance, and resources to enhance their performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Community Detection Algorithms in Biological Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Community detection in biological networks is crucial for understanding complex interactions among biological entities. This research focuses on performing community detection using several algorithms such as Kernighan lin bisection algorithm, Louvain algorithm, Girvan Newman algorithm, Fast Greedy algorithm, and Asynchronous fluid community algorithm on various biological datasets. We evaluated the modularity and partition quality for all the communities using all these algorithms separately and did a comparative analysis on the results. Using those results we were able to identify which algorithm is more efficient and scalable in performing the community detection for biological networks.

articleTitle: Advancement in Health Monitoring Through IOT and PostgreSQL Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source relational database management system (RDBMS) known for its robustness, extensibility, and standards compliance. Developed by a vibrant community of contributors, PostgreSQL offers advanced features that cater to the needs of both small-scale applications and large enterprises. One of PostgreSQL’s standout features is its support for complex data types, including arrays, hstore (key-value pairs), and JSONB (binary JSON). This versatility makes it suitable for handling diverse data types and accommodating evolving data models. With a strong emphasis on standards compliance, PostgreSQL adheres to SQL and ACID (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) properties, ensuring reliability and data integrity. Its extensibility is showcased through the availability of numerous extensions, allowing users to tailor the database to specific requirements. PostgreSQL’s support for indexing, advanced query optimization, and concurrency control mechanisms contributes to its exceptional performance. Furthermore, its transactional capabilities facilitate concurrent access to the database while maintaining data consistency.

articleTitle: Smart Thyroid Diagnosis: A Machine Learning Based Interactive System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Thyroid disease is an important part of diagnosis and prognostication is a strenuous problem in initiating fact-finding research. One of the most vital organs in our body is the thyroid. The thyroid glands release of hormones controls metabolism. Hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism are two disorders of the endocrine gland which secretes thyroid hormone to regulate the body’s metabolic rate. A data cleaning process was used to obtain sufficient raw data to analyze to indicate a patient’s susceptibility to thyroid conditions. The significance of machine learning is crucial. In the disease prediction process, and this article discusses the examination and categorization of thyroid illness models using Information gathered from the UCI Machine Learning Repository file. It is important to guarantee a strong base that can be combined and used as a hybrid model to difficult learning tasks such as diagnosis and prediction. In this piece, we’ll also go over a lot of research and thyroid protection tests. To forecast patients’ risk of thyroid illness, machine learning algorithms, K-NN, decision trees, and support vector machines are used.

articleTitle: Beyond Basic Emotions: High-Accuracy Facial Expression Classification Using a CNN-SVM Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Facial expression recognition, besides its widespread use for human-machine interaction and emotional understanding, is a hard-to-address task due to the complicated nature and fine features of facial movements. In this research, an innovative deep learning heuristic model is proffered with CNN which is used for feature extraction and SVM for classification. It is aimed at enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of facial expression classification. The main concern of our model is the expression that knits together the five emotions—happiness, sadness, fear, disgust, and contempt. It is trained and tested on an image dataset captured on the grounds of different conditions. The methodology consists of a two-stage process where CNN whose sole purpose is to derive high-level features that are fully segregated by the SVM’s classification pipeline. This method makes a smart application of two kinds of techniques for CNN specialization in conveying intricate and sophisticated features and SVM suitability as a quality classifier. The model accomplished an accuracy of 95.96% in discerning the facial expressions and thus is anticipated to surpass the existing methods of the only category in terms of reliability and accuracy. Our discovery shows that the hybrid CNN-SVM model is not only efficient but also makes it possible to stand out as a unique approach that could apply to other image classification (recognition) tasks by just tweaking things slightly. With the developed model, we can come up with new approaches for research in affective computing. At the same time, such AI technology can be implemented in the systems of emotion recognition making them much more intuitional and responsive.

articleTitle: Road Radar: Integrated Road Monitoring and Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Potholes pose a significant threat to road safety in India, contributing to serious traffic accidents. To address this issue, a camera-based system mounted in cars is proposed to detect any road irregularities in real time. The system utilizes You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection algorithm to identify road irregularities, followed by image processing algorithms to refine detections and improve accuracy. Additionally, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are employed to classify the severity of detected potholes. Real-time notifications are displayed on the dashboard to alert the driver when an obstacle is detected, and a buzzer inside the car sounds when the vehicle approaches an obstruction, in this case, ten meters, prompting the driver to slow down while simultaneously notifying the maintenance team about the pothole’s location. A graph will be generated which will include location of the pothole versus area of the pothole. The biggest pothole will be detected, then the maintenance team will try to make this location their priority and will attempt to fix that first in order to prevent major accidents. At the same time, the location that gets the highest number of notifications will be viewed and made a priority. The primary objective is to enhance road safety by alerting drivers to hazards like potholes in real-time, especially prevalent in India. Through YOLO, image processing, and CNN integration, the system aims to decrease accidents, promote cautious driving, and possibly reroute to safer paths, mitigating pothole-related accidents and enhancing overall road safety nationwide.

articleTitle: Advancing Citrus Disease Diagnosis: Application of EfficientNetB3 for Precise Classification of Orange Tree Pathologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This study investigates the application of the EfficientNetB3 convolutional neural network model for the classification of four major diseases affecting orange trees: canker, greasing, scab, and greening. since these citrus diseases are highly detrimental to the citrus output, and producing revenues, therefore, diagnosis of these diseases must be taken as a top priority and should be done as quickly as possible for effective management approaches to be implemented. By utilizing a dataset of leaf images that is quite comprehensive, the research relies on the EfficientNetB3 model, which is a classifier with different parameters, to come up with an effective classification system for the featured diseases. The research methodology consists of the data collection process, preprocessing, model training, and validation by using a model dataset split with a split of the dataset into training, validation, and test sets, to measure the robustness of the model. The evaluation of the EfficientNetB3 model is done based on accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score metrics, and based on the obtained results the model proved to be very effective and had an overall accuracy of 92.25% in disease classification. This proves how great deep learning models like EfficientNetB3 can be beneficial to the agricultural industry for outdoor plant disease diagnostics at high speed, even without practical work touching the thing or missing an essential quality. While the study concerns the utilization of artificial intelligence in plant pathology, it also reveals a certain level of the model’s superiority because it can improve plant disease management programs. Along with these findings, the research also identifies shortcomings and barriers. Among these are nil observations which might be misguided by the symptoms of similar diseases, therefore, indicating areas where model refinements and possibly application can be done.

articleTitle: Knee Osteoarthritis Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a common disease and the fourth leading cause of disability worldwide. It is the most common type of arthritis and degenerative knee disease that causes pain and limitation of motion, independence, and quality of life for millions of people. It is the most common type of arthritis, with more than 30 million people in the United States and more than 10 million people in Europe, South America, Asia, and the Middle East. Although there is currently no known cure, several biological, pharmacological, and environmental risk factors are thought to play a role in the emergence and advancement of this illness. This increases medical costs and the associated financial burden. Current standard treatments for osteoarthritis, including both pharmacological and symptomatic treatment, have limited effect on function and pain. In this proposed study, we used machine learning to create a model that predicts the risk of knee osteoarthritis. Machine learning techniques such as LSTM and CNN were used to create the models. Our model predicted the risk of knee osteoarthritis with an accuracy of 74%. Using the CNN method with small updates, the accuracy of the proposed model is improved to 96%. These models can be used to identify people at high risk of disease and assist them in taking preventive measures. This result has prompted stakeholders and large organizations to develop accurate models to predict the risk of knee osteoarthritis.

articleTitle: GDPR Compliant ChatGPT Playground
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: ChatGPT is an AI based conversational tool developed by OpenAPI on the design principles of Large Language Model (LLM) and a publicly accessible tool. ChatGPT has increasingly becoming popular tool for enabling applications involving interactive and contextual search across corporate companies, profit/non-profit organizations, educational/medical institutions, and researcher’s community to name a few.The corporate companies are abided by GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) compliance checks and restricted to share confidential, personal or sensitive information’s (hereinafter referred as critical data) into public domains. As ChatGPT server is hosted outside corporate boundaries, to fulfil GDPR compliance check, the corporate companies must have necessary systems in place of any data leaving outside of corporate boundaries.We are proposing a novel solution in identifying GDPR noncompliant DPP (Data Privacy and Protection) entities from the prompt query given to ChatGPT. To achieve this, from the corporate documents we first manually tag critical entities from “named entity tagging tool” in building the corporate specific DPP entities knowledgebase, build custom NER (Named Entity Recognition) model on top of prebuilt corporate specific DPP entities knowledgebase, an ChatGPT playground interface to accept any user’s prompt query, before firing the query to ChatGPT we validate the user’s prompt query against custom NER model to detect if any corporate specific DPP entities are present, warn the user by highlighting the corporate specific DPP entities if present to facilitate user in negating the same, we enabled feedback loop from the user for the highlighted corporate specific DPP entities to improvise the custom NER model and logging all the input prompt queries fired to ChatGPT to enable corporate auditing process by using techniques from Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Extraction, Information Retrieval (IR) and Custom NER model.

articleTitle: Group Person Identification and Communication Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This innovative project introduces a pioneering solution for group person identification and communication by using the power of Multi-Task Cascaded Convolutional Neural Networks (MT-CNNs). The system is designed to seamlessly identify individuals within a group photo and facilitate direct communication with them through the integrated platform, enhancing user interactions in various contexts. The project’s core objective revolves around the evolution of a strong MT-CNN-based model for precise person identification within group photographs. Leveraging state-of-the-art deep learning techniques, our model is trained on a diverse dataset, encompassing a large set of group sizes and compositions. Extensive preprocessing ensures accurate facial detection and alignment, setting the foundation for reliable person recognition. Upon successful identification, the system initiates direct communication channels with the recognized individuals. The user interface is designed for simplicity, enabling users to effortlessly upload photos, initiate person identification, and engage in immediate communication. This communication module is integrated into the framework to enable users to establish immediate contact with recognized individuals, fostering efficient and meaningful interactions. This project’s innovative nature lies in its ability to lessen the distance between digital and physical worlds, offering a transformative solution for enhanced social interactions.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Detection Using Anterior Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Pneumonia is a common lung infection in developing and underdeveloped countries. Analysis of anterior chest x-ray is the most commonly used method to diagnose lung infections. Existing methods provide reasonable accuracies at the price of very high model sizes. Such a high memory requirement is contrary to the primary use case of such models, which is for a preliminary check from a place with access to less resources. We propose a lightweight neural network model to detect pneumonia in anterior chest x-ray images. The proposed model is trained to detect pneumonia in chest x-ray images utilizing contrast enhancement and progressive resizing.

articleTitle: Decentralized File Storage Platform using IPFS and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This paper presents a pioneering web application that combines Inter Planetary File System (IPFS) and Blockchain technology to meet the increasing demand for secure, scalable, and decentralized data storage. The system utilizes locally-hosted Digital Ocean droplets as gateways, eliminating reliance on third-party companies and maintaining decentralization. By integrating blockchain technology, the application enhances security through transaction authentication and access permission management. It offers features such as access control, file integrity checking using IPFS hashes, and the potential for future enhancements like a custom cryptocurrency for transactions. This innovative system provides a practical, decentralized alternative to mainstream cloud storage services, ensuring data privacy, security, and integrity while granting users greater authority over their data.

articleTitle: Integrating EfficientNet and Fine-Tuned DenseNet Models for Advanced Detection and Classification of Guava Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This article focuses on the anthellusian method of recognizing and identifying diseases of guavas using a hybrid CNN model, which takes advantage of the high performance of EfficientNet and the adaptability of Fine-Tuned DenseNet. Guava (Psidium guajava), which is a big agricultural product and has very high export demands, can suffer from deterioration of health due to various diseases. Classical procedures, which rely solely on discovery and examination by experts, are not movable and they could lead to mistakes. This is an introduction of a deep learning-centric solution to this issue that the proposed method describes as a scalable and robust instrument for accurate diagnosis of guava diseases. The proposed model is meticulously trained and validated on a comprehensive dataset comprising high-resolution images of guava leaves affected by five primary conditions: Beta-carotene, lycopene, anthocyanins, lutein, zeaxanthin, and many other antioxidants you probably haven’t heard of. Red Rust, Styler End Rot, Saab, Phytophthora rot, and healthy specimens. In that, intensive feature engineering will be the base on which the model’s training procedure is built. The combination of EfficientNet with Fine-Tuned DenseNet models exploits their complementary scaling and sharing features, thereby, contributing to their excellence in disease diagnosis. Output from the integration test of the model indicates the overall accuracy of 94.7 % on guava disease classification, which is higher than the existing methods and sets a new reference level in the field. A point-by-point investigation of the performance of the model by calculating its confusion/error matrix identifies the model’s strong and weak sides, as well as challenges such as classifying diseases that have visual symptoms similar to others. However, the implication of such a study goes beyond academic interest as it offers unique approaches that can be applied in practice by farmers, agronomists, and the agricultural industry which are all concerned with the productivity and adaptability of their practices in the face of climate change.

articleTitle: Maximizing Shelf Life Efficiency: Enhancing Sustainability through Smart Food Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The global food industry grapples with the need to maximize agricultural produce utilization and minimize the huge amounts of waste which, on its own, can solve world hunger. Food wastage also comes with a huge environmental impact in the form of soil degradation, clean water loss, etc. This paper proposes a sophisticated smart processing and allocation system, driven by data-driven decision-making and predictive analytics. By integrating real-time updates and historical data and a system architecture enabling informed decision-making, the system optimizes the allocation of crops, fruits, and vegetables, reducing food waste and enhancing sustainability. The advantages include minimized food waste, improved food security, enhanced sustainability, and cost efficiency. This approach is essential in addressing the critical issue of food allocation, combating food waste, and hunger, and safeguarding the environment for future generations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety and ITS Efficiency: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Traffic Sign Detection using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Smart transportation systems (ITS) and autonomous vehicles hereby require up-to-date, highly accurate, and essential tools for sign detection with efficiency. This research paper presents a detailed evaluation of the You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLOv8) deep learning model for the detection and classification of traffic signs into four pivotal categories: red lights, stop signs, speed cameras, as well as crosswalks. The current study introduces a dataset from the Kaggle repository for a thorough investigation of model performance that simulates practical situations in which the weather is unstable and advanced signs vary in shape. The YOLOv8 model used sophisticated methodologies, which encompassed dataset preparation, model training, and solid evaluation metrics; which at the end of the day, showed that this model was better in sensitivity, specificity, and f1-scores, and at the same time, enabled real-time processing that applies to mobility and traffic management. It shows that YOLOv8 is much better than all the previous standard algorithms, as well, it is placed to be one of their best solutions in traffic sign detection. Regularly, conducted by the researchers contribute to the academic field because they present real-world evidence of the YOLOv8 model influence as well as providing practical implications for the future development of road safety and the operational efficiency of ITS and autonomous vehicles. The occurrence of such a location sets the scene for the development of novel traffic sign detection techniques, stressing the prospects of inputting improved approaches and the compilation of heterogeneous data to help in the categorization of the complex surrounding driving environments.

articleTitle: Construction of a Biomedical Knowledge Graph using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Biomedical Named Entity Linking (NEL) plays a crucial role in extracting valuable information from text for downstream tasks in bioinformatics. However, challenges like entity ambiguity and complex relationships hinder accurate entity linking. We demonstrate the effectiveness of BERN2, a novel neural network architecture designed to address these challenges and improve NEL performance, by linking entities to a knowledge graph stored in a Neo4j graph database. This combination allows for efficient exploration of intricate relationships between entities, facilitating advanced biomedical research. Furthermore, we showcase the utility of leveraging node embedding techniques on the knowledge graph for various machine-learning applications in the biomedical domain. Our findings suggest that BERN2, coupled with knowledge graphs and node embeddings, can significantly enhance biomedical information extraction and empower researchers with powerful tools for collaborative healthcare research and accelerated discoveries.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Charity Integrity System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The proposed blockchain-based fundraising model for NGOs ensures transparency and data integrity for charity by employing a decentralized digital ledger with blocks containing immutable transaction records. Through smart contracts, it establishes a direct and efficient channel between donors and NGOs, eliminating external intermediaries. This decentralized network architecture allows real-time monitoring and validation of transactions, fostering trust and accountability. The system can be further used to develop decentralized applications like supply chain management by eliminating third-party involvement

articleTitle: Enhancing Wireless Sensor Network Longevity and Security: A Quad-LEACH Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Researchers have increasingly focused on Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) in recent years, recognizing their versatile applications. The primary focus within WSNs is enhancing network longevity for efficient resource utilization, coupled with a strong emphasis on security and authentication. This paper specifically delves into the implementation of Quad LEACH for homogeneous networks, aiming to substantially improve network lifetime, stability, and throughput. The proposed protocol achieves this by employing a cluster head selection process and integrating security and authentication measures between cluster heads in the Quad-LEACH routing protocol. The research addresses the integration of a security agent within WSNs using the NS-2 tool, contributing to enhanced authentication. The implementation is carried out through the simulation software NS 2, where the security agent is seamlessly combined with the WSN infrastructure. The objective of this research is to incorporate a reliable authentication and security agent into NS-2 in conjunction with the LEACH protocol, which is the standard for wireless sensors networks (WSNs). The efficacy of the suggested methodology will be validated through simulated outcomes.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Identification of Arrhythmia using Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Classification of cardiac issues has been a major topic of research over the decades. But, since 2000s due to the scope of implementation using the concepts of Machine learning, Artificial intelligence that came into persistence due to growth of computational power, lot of scope has been detected for computer automated disease detection, early diagnosis, personalized healthcare. Arrhythmia is one such heart related disease where it would lead to abnormalities in the functioning of heart either due to fast heartbeats often called the Tachycardia or the slow heartbeats often called the Bradycardia. The novel method of arrhythmia detection is using the ECG (Electrocardiogram) which studies the condition of the heart using the electric impulse. In this research we have considered the popularly known MIT-BIH dataset which contains the 48hr continuous diagnosis. Initially we have considered the ECG images, divide them under Train, test, validation splits and have implemented a classifier called EfficientNetB4 using Deep neural networks which attained a training accuracy of 98% and validation accuracy of 91% where the classifier could correctly classify the ECG images under appropriate classes.

articleTitle: Forecasting Airline Customer Satisfaction through the Application of Diverse Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Airline customer satisfaction encapsulates passengers’ overall happiness with an airline’s services, spanning aspects like booking, in-flight experience, and customer service. It is a crucial metric for airline success, influencing brand loyalty and reputation. Achieving and maintaining high customer satisfaction is integral to airlines’ competitiveness and long-term viability in the dynamic aviation industry. This study examines a dataset comprising 129,880 customer records within the airline industry, subjecting it to evaluation by machine learning models, including logistic regression, decision tree, and random forest. Among these, the random forest model stands out, yielding the most favorable results with an accuracy exceeding $94 \%$. This outcome emphasizes the efficacy of employing advanced machine learning techniques for precise predictions in the domain of airline customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Lokart: Empowering Local Artisans through Mobile E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)

authors.preferredName: V. V. S. N Akhila Sree Rajeswari

abstract: Lokart, a mobile application developed using Flutter SDK and powered by Google Firebase, aims to empower local artisans in Machilipatnam, including small-scale jewellers, by addressing the challenges they face in accessing markets and selling their products. Through Lokart, artisans can showcase and sell their products directly to customers, eliminating the need for intermediaries and expensive marketing apps. Leveraging real-time database capabilities, Lokart ensures a seamless, secure, and efficient e-commerce experience, providing customers with access to high-quality products at affordable prices with minimal delivery time. Additionally, Lokart offers a B2B feature, enabling artisans to sell raw materials and goods to businesses, thereby expanding their market reach and economic opportunities. This paper discusses the development and implementation of Lokart, highlighting its unique features and benefits for artisans and customers alike. By fostering economic empowerment within local communities and streamlining business operations for artisans, Lokart has the potential to make a significant impact on the e-commerce landscape for small-scale businesses.

articleTitle: The Evolution and Impact of Game Development in the Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This research paper aims to explore the evolution and impact of game development in the digital era. It delves into the historical progression of gaming, examines technological advancements influencing game development, analyzes the socio-cultural impact of games, and discusses the future trends and challenges in this field.

articleTitle: CNN-Based Hevea Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The paper is about the detection of hevea tree leaf disease detection. Phytophthora sp. caused the abnormal leaf fall (ALF) disease; Oidium heveae caused powdery mildew (PM); Colletotrichum spp. caused colletotrichum leaf spot (CLS), and Corynespora cassiicola caused corynespora leaf fall (CLF) were the diseases that were frequently found in hevea trees. According to the study, ALF, PM, and CLS were present in almost all of the plantations surveyed, although CLF was less common in mountainous locations. CLS and CLF were reported in Subramanya, Puttur, Belthangady, Kundapura, and Sullia, exacerbating the devastation. Numerous foliar diseases are known to cause considerable yield losses in rubber trees. As of right now, numerous rubber plantations in nations that produce rubber are being impacted by a new, severe leaf disease epidemic that is being classified as Pestalotiopsis secondary leaf fall. In addition to Fusicoccum leaf blight and Phytophthora abnormal leaf fall, these leaf diseases also include secondary leaf falls of Oidium, Colletotrichum, and Corynespora. With an emphasis on the pathogens responsible, the symptoms, and the impact on rubber plantations, this paper provides an overview of the major leaf diseases and the recent epidemic. To try to minimize or even completely avoid latex yield losses, the information provided would help organize and launch improved control measures for rubber-growing regions.

articleTitle: From MongoDB to React: Unleashing the Power of MERN in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This report delves into the dynamic landscape of online ethnic wear commerce in India, examining the transformative influence of e-commerce on the retail market. Projections suggest significant growth driven by improved internet accessibility, positioning India as a global force in online business. The report investigates the role of web applications and the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) in shaping the ethnic wear e-commerce landscape, emphasizing their flexibility, scalability, and user-friendly features. The methodology for developing an ethnic wear e-commerce website using the MERN stack is detailed, highlighting its adaptability and scalability. Additionally, the report emphasizes the impact of e-commerce on consumer behavior, logistics, and environmental sustainability. In conclusion, the technical aspects of application design, system architecture, user interface design, database design, models, and dependencies are outlined, providing insights into the robust and high-performing nature of the developed e-commerce application.

articleTitle: Unlocking Cloud Efficiency: Blockchain DeDuplication Optimizes Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The way people live and work has changed as a result of offloading information to cloud capacity, which brings down data administration costs and increments efficiency. Individuals may utilize their gadgets to download information from cloud capacity at any time and from any area. It suggests that cloud capacity allows for the sharing of information between locations. That being said, there are several challenges associated with shifting information to cloud capacity, like understanding the execution bottleneck and achieving safe information exchange. Because blockchain is tamper-evident, it has become essential to secure information sharing. This work proposes a blockchain-assisted information sharing scheme that carries out the deduplication discovery and completes the deduplication of the ciphertext combination. Blockchain technology is used to assist verify the ciphertext’s validity by using its tamper-evident characteristics. Additionally, fractional ciphertext parameters are computed in spare time to advance server operating expertise. At last, we reproduced all of the calculations for the recommended conspire on the PBC library, and the comes about appear that it accomplishes a adjust between execution and convenience.

articleTitle: Airline Customer Reviews Analysis and Booking Completion Prediction using Data Visualization and Machine Learning for British Airways
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This study focuses on analyzing airline customer reviews and predicting booking trends, specifically for British Airways. The objectives include interpreting customer sentiments from reviews, identifying key themes, and examining the relationship between these sentiments and factors like flight duration and service offerings. A significant aspect of this research is developing a predictive model to forecast booking outcomes. Methodologically, the study utilizes the Extra Trees Classifier for feature selection, focusing on 8 primary features, and employs the SMOTE technique for dealing with an unbalanced dataset. The predictive models experimented comprise of Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). The models achieved an accuracy rate of 96%, 94%, 92%, and 94% respectively for booking prediction. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining machine learning and text analytics in the airline industry, offering valuable insights for strategic decision-making.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power SPI Protocol using Clock Gating Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: This research explores the integration of clock gating techniques to enhance the performance of the Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI) protocol commonly used in embedded systems. This approach involves selectively disabling the clock signal during idle states of the blocks, resulting in significant reductions in power consumption while maintaining high-speed and reliable data transfer. Through extensive simulations and experimental validations, our study demonstrates the efficiency of the proposed clock gating strategy in achieving a balance between power consumption and communication speed. This research not only benefits SPI applications but also serves as a model for optimizing other communication protocols. The results presented in this paper offer valuable insights into implementation challenges and considerations associated with integrating clock gating into the SPI protocol, paving the way for further advancements in power-aware design methodologies.

articleTitle: Early Prediction and Diagnosis Cardiovascular Disease Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk assessment and prognosis in otherwise healthy people is an important part of disease management. Early detection and diagnosis of CVD, supported by the extensive health data on the condition already stored in hospital systems, has the ability to greatly improve disease outcomes. Clinical practice for the management of Cardiovascular Diseases (CVDs) stands to benefit greatly from the use of machine learning approaches. Patients and the healthcare system can save money thanks to these methods, which can be used to create evidence-based clinical guidelines and management algorithms. This will cut down on expensive and time-consuming clinical and laboratory examinations. This study suggests creating new deep learning algorithms that can automatically identify important variables and detect early-stage heart disease; these algorithms should be resilient, effective, efficient, and unique in order to improve early anticipation and interference for CVDs. An F1-score of around 89% is produced by the suggested Catboost model. Hence, it outperformed numerous other state-of-the-art methods by maximizing classification efficiency with better correctness and precision.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Learning for Melanoma Skin Cancer Diagnosis: Unravelling Representations in Dermoscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: The study provides an innovative system for identifying melanoma skin cancer using Dermoscopic images and self-supervised learning (SSL). Existing systems for melanoma diagnoses frequently rely on supervised learning, which requires large labelled datasets for training and might be constrained by data availability and bias. The proposed system solves these difficulties by utilizing SSL techniques, allowing the model to extract meaningful representations from input without needing explicit labels. The methodology includes data collection, preparation, and creation of a self-supervised learning system based on SimCLR and the ResNet-50 architecture. The results show that the proposed system outperforms existing systems across multiple datasets and skin types, with high accuracy (0.92), precision (0.93), recall (0.93), and F1 score (0.94). Furthermore, the approach improves interpretability and diagnostic accuracy, demonstrating its potential as a valuable tool in melanoma detection across various clinical situations. The research emphasizes the importance of SSL in tackling issues in medical image classification, particularly in dermatology, and provides a viable route for increasing melanoma detection speed and reliability.

articleTitle: Advancements in Left Ventricular Myocardium Analysis: A Comprehensive Review of Myocardium Segmentation, Fibrosis Detection and Wall Motion Estimation Using Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging (CMRI) has established itself as a cornerstone in cardiovascular diagnostics, enabling precise assessment of left ventricular (LV) myocardium. This review meticulously examines the multifaceted aspects of LV myocardium analysis, focusing on three pivotal components: myocardium segmentation, fibrosis detection, and wall motion estimation. By exploring cutting-edge techniques and methodologies in these domains, this article sheds light on the profound impact CMR has had on the accurate diagnosis, prognosis and structuring treatment plans for diseases of the heart. In the realm of cardiac diagnostics, Left Ventricular (LV) myocardium analysis utilizing CMRI has undergone a transformation advancement. This review encapsulates the comprehensive exploration of LV myocardium analysis, Myocardium segmentation techniques, ranging from traditional methods to contemporary machine learning-driven approaches, are scrutinized for their accuracy and efficiency. The detection and characterization of myocardial fibrosis, crucial in diagnosing various cardiac conditions, are dissected through cutting-edge CMR techniques such as Late Gadolinium Enhancement (LGE) imaging and quantitative mapping methods. Additionally, advanced methods of wall motion estimation, including feature tracking and strain imaging, highlighting their applications in assessing myocardial function. Real-world clinical scenarios underscore the transformation impact of these techniques on diagnosing heart diseases, guiding treatment decisions, and improving patient outcomes. The current landscape of LV myocardium analysis, emphasizing the pivotal role of CMR in revolutionizing cardiac healthcare.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Deep Learning Models for Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Plant disease identification is critical for lowering output losses and guaranteeing food security. This study looks at the use of four common transfer learning models for early plant disease detection: MobileNet, VGG19, AlexNet, and ResNet. The study compares their ability in properly distinguishing damaged plant leaves from healthy ones. The emphasis is on assessing their performance with minimal training data, which is a typical difficulty in agricultural datasets. The accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score obtained by each model on diverse plant disease datasets are presented in the study. The paper lays out each model’s merits and limitations, underlining its fit for various circumstances.

articleTitle: “Vulnerabilities in Smart Contracts: A Detailed Survey of Detection and Mitigation Methodologies”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: In the ever-changing world of blockchain technology, the emergence of smart contracts has completely transformed the way agreements are executed, offering the potential for automation and trust in decentralized systems. Despite their built-in security features, smart contracts still face persistent vulnerabilities, resulting in significant financial losses. While existing studies often approach smart contract security from specific angles, such as development cycles or vulnerability detection tools, this paper adopts a comprehensive, multidimensional perspective. It delves into the intricacies of smart contract security by examining vulnerability detection mechanisms and defense strategies. The exploration begins by conducting a detailed analysis of the current security challenges and issues surrounding smart contracts. It then delves into established frameworks for classifying vulnerabilities and common security flaws. The paper examines existing methods for detecting, and repairing contract vulnerabilities, evaluating their effectiveness. Additionally, it provides a comprehensive overview of the existing body of knowledge in smart contract security-related research. Through this systematic examination, the paper aims to serve as a valuable reference and provide a comprehensive understanding of the multifaceted landscape of smart contract security.

articleTitle: GAN Based Model for Virtual Try On of Clothes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: E-commerce platforms focused on fashion, imagebased virtual try-on solutions have shown considerable potential for enhancing the user experience and increasing customer satisfaction. The $2 D$ solutions that exist fail to provide a complete satisfactory experience as they lack the capability to take into consideration customer-specific postures and modifications. They rely majorly on generative models due to which reconstructionof high-quality images of the clothing is difficult. The clothing in $3 D V T$ solutions is created as $3 D$ models, which are thendraped on $3 D$ human avatars with various body types. A huge catalog of digitized $3 D$ garment and clothing models is a crucial requirement for a $3 D$ VT system, but this requirement requires expensive multiview capture/scan equipment and cannot scaleup for big catalog volumes, especially in the current fast-fashion settings. Hence, we propose a video virtual Try-On model which is based on fully learnable characteristics preserving virtual try on network $C P$ VTON [3]. It first forms a TSP for transforming clothes to fit the target body shape via Geometric Matching Module.Then use a GAN based model for pose transfer.The accuracy resulting from such a model could help in decreasing the waiting time in traditional stores, and also help in decreasing sanitizing costs.

articleTitle: Emergency Aid HUB for Instant First Aid and Emergency Call
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
abstract: Technology can be a valuable tool in an emergency to resolve the situation. With the rapid increase in mobile users, coupled with the alarming instances of fatalities due to the lack of first aid knowledge during emergencies, this mobile application has been developed to bridge the gap and empower users with life-saving skills and information. The idea behind this paper is to create an Android application to provide essential assistance during critical situations. The app encompasses four primary features: comprehensive first aid details, instant access to emergency numbers, medical assistance through a chatbot, and users can view recent articles. This application is a vital tool for individuals, families, and communities seeking to enhance their emergency preparedness and response capabilities. Its intuitive design and user-friendly interface make it accessible to all age groups, including literate and illiterate people, ensuring that help is just a click away when needed.

articleTitle: AI Powered Indicatorless Algorithmic Trading Bot for Cryptocurrency and Financial Market
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Technologies in Computer Science for Interdisciplinary Applications (ICETCS)
